title: Measure the fixed context of a worker run
body:
Workers use 100k–700k tokens per run; the fixed share (instructions, skills, tool schemas, MCP servers) is unknown. Measure the first-turn input tokens of an empty Codex worker run and of a Claude subagent, list the largest contributors, and trim what workers do not use.
Acceptance: a measured before/after of first-turn input tokens with the change that reduced it.
